description: One dataset item per scraped comment or reply. Rows for videos that could not be scraped contain only videoId/videoUrl and an error message instead of comment fields.

authorChannelId.description: Channel ID of the comment author.

authorChannelUrl.description: URL of the comment author's channel.

authorIsChannelOwner.description: Whether the author is the owner of the video's channel (the creator).

authorIsVerified.description: Whether the author's channel is verified.

authorName.description: Display name / handle of the comment author.

commentId.description: YouTube's unique ID of the comment.

commentUrl.description: Direct URL to the comment on YouTube.

error.description: Error message; present only on rows for videos that could not be scraped.

isHearted.description: Whether the creator gave the comment a heart.

isPinned.description: Whether the comment is pinned by the creator.

isReply.description: Whether this row is a reply to another comment.

likeCount.description: Number of likes on the comment, parsed from YouTube's display value.

likeCountText.description: Raw like-count text as displayed by YouTube (e.g. "570K").

parentCommentId.description: ID of the parent comment for replies; null for top-level comments.

publishedAtEstimate.description: Estimated absolute publish timestamp (ISO 8601), derived from the relative display time.

publishedTimeText.description: Relative publish time as displayed by YouTube (e.g. "6 years ago").

replyCount.description: Number of replies to the comment, when reported by YouTube.

scrapedAt.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601) when the comment was scraped.

videoChannelName.description: Channel name of the source video.

videoId.description: YouTube video ID the comment belongs to.

videoUrl.description: Input video URL; present on error rows.

title: YouTube comment

overview.description: Most important comment fields at a glance.
overview.title: Comments
